cases.title: Explicit remote-open mode serves HTTP/SSE without a token and rejects cross-origin browsers
assertions: explicit open mode never reads or requires an access token
HTTP and SSE are reachable without Authorization or Cookie
cross-origin browser requests fail before subscribing or mutating
trusted proxy origin is compared against the effective public origin

cases.title: Explicit remote-open Terminal WebSocket is tokenless but exact same-origin
assertions: open mode accepts an exact same-origin WebSocket without a token
cross-origin upgrades are rejected
query-string tokens are not credentials
token-protected remote mode still rejects a tokenless loopback hop

cases.title: Opt-in read-only probe of a remote development Dutydeck HTTP/SSE/Terminal WS endpoint
safety: probe sends no Authorization, Cookie, terminal input, or mutation request
base URL may not contain userinfo, query, or fragment
the supplied session must be a dedicated disposable PTY-CLI session
assertions: auth status reports required=false
session HTTP is reachable without a token
SSE connects with the exact public Origin and cross-Origin fails
Terminal WS connects with the exact public Origin and cross-Origin fails

cases.title: SecretProvider and secret CLI preserve metadata-only, private-file and fail-closed boundaries
assertions: Secret values enter through an FD/runtime-only callback, are never accepted on argv or persisted in metadata, and input buffers are wiped
provider directories and files are private, exclusive and symlink-safe
rotation/removal use CAS and referenced SecretRefs cannot be removed
missing or unreadable SecretRefs keep ChannelBots staged and activation-ineligible

cases.title: Importer core emits a redacted NO_GO plan and never mutates its synthetic Botmux source
assertions: production_cutover is NO_GO and activation_ready is false
Hammer, enabled Schedule, active topic, and unknown configuration are blockers
plans and manifests contain no raw App, chat, principal, path, prompt, or secret
source tree digest is unchanged after plan and encrypted archive

cases.title: Importer CLI discover, plan and archive remain redacted, exclusive and non-activating
assertions: the CLI exposes discover, plan and archive but no apply/stage/activate/cutover/resume command
discover and plan stay NO_GO, redact paths/identities/secrets and leave the source digest unchanged
redacted outputs use exclusive 0600 files and refuse overwrite or symlink targets
archive requires an explicit non-argv passphrase FD, writes 0700/0600 encrypted output and never changes the source

cases.title: A completed Dutydeck-owned run reattaches on the same pane PID after service restart and final stop destroys it
assertions: two service lifetimes use the same isolated SQLite database
the second service lazily reconnects the persisted session without an eager duplicate driver
the tmux pane PID is unchanged after the post-restart turn
both completed prompts remain persisted
explicit final session stop destroys the tmux session
the wrapper leaves no tmux session in its isolated TMUX_TMPDIR namespace

cases.title: An active turn survives daemon loss and reconstructs its exact final result after reconnect
blocked_by: the WP2 service test restarts only between completed turns
runtime initialization currently classifies tasks left running by the prior process as interrupted
no service-level test reconstructs the terminal result, task completion, and delivery identity for a turn active during restart

cases.title: Agent, ChannelBot and GroupBinding resolve App+Chat routing, mention/topic and group-tool ceilings offline
assertions: effective config resolves bot defaults and per-chat overrides deterministically
mention=topic and group reply=chat-topic retain group_override provenance
oncall grants talk only and group-tool send cannot exceed the ChannelBot ceiling
management API returns an allowlisted App+Chat matrix without raw principals or secrets

cases.title: can_talk, can_operate and admin remain distinct in the persisted policy and management authorizer
assertions: oncall/all-chat membership grants can_talk without can_operate or admin
role assignments retain independent operate scopes and action gates
management writes require the owner/admin resolver and token mode has no anonymous fallback
managed staged bindings fail closed while explicitly isolated legacy execution remains legacy_unmanaged

cases.title: Terminal write and group-tool send require explicit independent high-risk gates
assertions: Terminal WS re-authorizes read and write separately and closes denied writes with a machine-readable policy code
group-tool read/discover/send pass through the injected policy evaluator
can_operate or full trust alone does not override terminalWrite, highRisk or groupToolsSend gates
managed staged/disabled bindings deny session, terminal, high-risk and group-tool execution

cases.title: Unwired and staged ChannelBot, GroupBinding and Schedule foundations fail closed at every management boundary
assertions: missing repositories and permission evaluators produce machine-readable denial
ChannelBots and GroupBindings can only be staged or disabled and cannot activate listeners
Schedule routes expose no enable or run-now operation
raw secrets, plaintext-like fields and raw principal PII are rejected without echo

cases.title: Schedule foundation proves DST semantics, generation-pinned idempotency, watermark and CAS lease offline
assertions: IANA timezone, DST gap/overlap, cron and interval preview semantics are deterministic
occurrence idempotency keys are stable, generation-pinned and advance only the planning watermark
lease acquire/renew/fence/reacquire require CAS proof and an expired held lease cannot be stolen
imported enabled Botmux schedules remain source-owned pending, staged_disabled and non-dispatchable
offline API can list/edit/preview but has no enable, run-now, timer or listener

cases.title: Schedule executor, timer and activation remain intentionally unavailable
blocked_by: the v13 foundation creates only task_run_snapshot intent with dispatchAllowed=false
no timer, outbox worker or production Schedule executor is registered
management API deliberately has no enable or run-now operation

cases.title: App×Chat identity preflight uses loopback fake Lark and remains activation-ineligible
safety: all remote calls terminate at a per-test loopback fake Lark server on an ephemeral port
all SecretProvider files and SQLite state live under the runner case-private TMPDIR
no listener is started and no activation or cutover route is invoked
assertions: successful App×Chat verification uses only read-only identity, membership and chat probes and persists version-bound facts
local App mismatch, remote App mismatch, missing SecretRef value and unreadable SecretRef value fail closed
not-member and inaccessible chat evidence produce non-sensitive blockers
a definitive failed recheck CAS-invalidates the last successful identity and bound chat facts
API and CLI public projections exclude secrets, tokens, raw App/chat/open_id/tenant identities, names and upstream error payloads
success still returns activationChanged=false and listenerReadiness=blocked while the ChannelBot remains staged/disabled

cases.title: Listener lease and cross-runtime fencing prevent dual consumption and preserve rollback watermarks
blocked_by: no production listener lease is acquired, renewed, fenced or released by Dutydeck
a future Dutydeck-local lease alone cannot stop Botmux reconnect
no shared supervisor enforces one App generation across both runtimes
drain acknowledgement, source/target watermarks, dedup window, and mechanical rollback are absent

cases.title: Opt-in real Lark parity probe on a dedicated test App and chat
blocked_by: a repository runner must not obtain or reuse existing Lark credentials
an external operator-owned driver is required after identity and fencing preflight
the current production Botmux Apps/listeners are explicitly out of scope
safety: App-scoped bot identity and App+Chat membership must be positively verified
Botmux listener must be drained and reconnect-inhibited by an external fence
target listener must remain disabled until the external test driver owns the generation
no credential or raw App/chat/open_id is stored in this suite
